statement: On LK = (Z/KZ)3, let d∞ be the periodic maximum distance. A random datum D determines a bad set B ⊂ LK satisfying P(A ⊂ B) ≤ p|A| (A ⊂ LK). Fix an integer contact radius rc ≥ 1, an integer q ≥ 0, and cQ > 0. Let Q be a projected lattice cube of side at most cQR, and let z be a site such that every y ∈ Q has forward first-coordinate displacement from z in [.29K, .46K]. There are constants p0, κ, c, C, C0 > 0 and R0, depending only on the fixed parameters, with the following properties when R ≥ R0, K ≥ C0R, and p ≤ p0. Put H = ⌊R1/2⌋. There is an event E, determined by D, z, Q, on which one can sample simple good nearest-neighbor routes πy from z to every y ∈ Q. Conditional on D, different samples use independent fresh randomness. The event E includes the requirement that the 10R-neighborhoods of z and Q contain no bad sites. For π = (v0, . . . , vm) starting at z, put a(π) = max{i : d∞(vi, z) ≤ H}, πch = {vi : i > a(π)}. The initial portion (v0, . . . , va(π)) has at most CH vertices. The analogous portion read backwards from the terminal site also has at most CH vertices, and these two portions are disjoint. Let πch,q contain the vertices whose path index is within q of an index in πch. For independent samples πy, πy′ , set Jc = X v∈πy X v′∈πy′ 1{d∞(v,v′)≤rc}, J∗ = X v∈πch,q y X v′∈πch,q y′ 1{d∞(v,v′)≤rc}. Uniformly in the specified endpoints, ED  1EEroutes(eκJc | D)  ≤ C. Finally, if M is the stated bad-free margin event, then P(M \ E) ≤ K3 (Ap)⌊K/(10(rc+2))⌋ + CR3 e−cR , (6.3) where A is fixed and Ap0 < 1.
